beforeImage.name: FlexiVan
beforeImage.description: FlexiVan leases and manages intermodal chassis used in North American container transport. Its customers include ocean carriers, ports, logistics providers, and drayage users that require marine chassis and fleet management services. The business follows an asset-heavy transportation model based on owned chassis fleets, maintenance networks, and recurring leasing revenues. Public materials indicate that the company was founded in 1955 and operates one of the largest chassis fleets in the United States, measured at more than 120,000 units in recent disclosures. I Squared took a controlling interest in FlexiVan in January 2020 by combining the company with American Intermodal Management, while Castle & Cooke retained a minority position; exact ownership percentages were not publicly disclosed. The transaction created a larger platform across intermodal equipment leasing and fleet management.

afterImage.name: FlexiVan
afterImage.description: FlexiVan is a North American marine-chassis leasing and fleet-management platform serving ocean carriers, ports, logistics providers and drayage users. The company operates more than 120,000 chassis and offers pools, rentals, maintenance and AIM360 telematics across major U.S. intermodal markets. I Squared Capital completed its controlling investment on February 18, 2020 by combining American Intermodal Management into FlexiVan through its first global infrastructure fund. Castle & Cooke announced that it would retain a minority interest, but its current status and the parties' exact percentages are not publicly reconfirmed. Transportation Equipment Network is a distinct I Squared platform and is not consolidated into this record. No later FlexiVan sale, recapitalization or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
